  "summary": "This 11 February 1976 Swatantra Party circular, signed by its president G.K. Sundaram, asks party workers to continue operating through constitutional, peaceful, and non-violent methods. Against the backdrop of the early dissolution of the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly and the imposition of President’s Rule, Sundaram advises workers to avoid prohibited or unlawful activity, limit organising to individual contacts and very small groups, and concentrate on enrolling new members and explaining the party’s principles.\n\nThe circular also argues that public opinion will eventually turn toward discussion of the country’s underlying problems, despite what it describes as one-sided propaganda reaching much of the illiterate population. Its accompanying press statement welcomes the Government of India’s appointment of a one-man commission to investigate corruption allegations against former ministers of the DMK Ministry, while criticising the action as at least five years overdue and calling for comparable commissions to investigate allegations involving other former and serving ministers.",
